text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Haah, haah, haah—

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...No pain in my hoof.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"...Ms. Jordan.
There was something I wanted to ask about pedicures――"

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Wh-What?! Cafe?!
Since when did you start doing your nails...?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...I received it from Nakayama-san.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Aah! That thing!
Was it for Cafe?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Mind takin' off your socks for a sec?
Lemme take a look at your nails.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Huh...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
I wanted to see it in person, y'know?
Like, maybe there's nail art that matches even better, right?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...!
Thank... you...
(Rattle, rattle!)

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...I'm fine. I'm not pushing myself.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
More importantly, let us go to France.
For the race I envision awaits us there—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Well, well, Cafe!
It's certainly gotten lively around you, hasn't it!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Beyond that "friend" of hers,
yet another bond has begun to form.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Was the catalyst 'Project L'Arc', perhaps?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...I wonder.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"The night breeze is cold.
It still hasn't reached my 'friend's' back."

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"...I want to be faster than that back.
To do that... I have to take the path
she showed me—the road to France."

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"...That was the only thought in my mind as I kept running.
That's why—"

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: I couldn't understand why "that" was necessary now of all times.

One evening, when I happened to stop by
the training course—

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
What kind of relationship do you all
have with your "friend"?

I turned around in the direction Manhattan Cafe pointed.
Yet no one was there.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
..."Come with me",
my "friend" says.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ......Just me alone should have been enough, and yet.

Manhattan Cafe seems deeply brooding over something.
Just as I was about to call out to her—

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...The next Representative Exchange Race.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
On race day, I will beat you all.
...Without fail.
